enabled.title: Enable TLP Mail Marker
enabled.description: Set to false to disable the extension for all users.

domains.title: Authorised webmail hosts
domains.description: Hostnames where the extension is allowed to run. Users cannot remove these. Grant host access with the ExtensionSettings runtime_allowed_hosts policy.

allowUserDomains.title: Allow users to add their own webmail hosts
allowUserDomains.description: When false, only the hosts in the domains policy are used.

missingClassification.title: Action when sending without a classification

warnOnDowngrade.title: Warn when a reply or forward lowers the classification

markSubject.title: Add the TLP label to the subject line

markBody.title: Add the TLP label at the top of the message body

allowedLevels.title: Permitted TLP classifications
allowedLevels.description: Restrict the selector to this subset of TLP 2.0 labels.

defaultLevel.title: Default classification for new messages
defaultLevel.description: Preselected for brand-new messages only. Must be within allowedLevels.
